project.title: Dev Ops

parentsummary.deliverables: Transformed the Lowe Martin software development team from an unstructured model to an Agile and Scrum-based delivery organization, standing up Atlassian JIRA and Confluence with a permission scheme separating internal from Government of Canada client access, deploying an ITIL-based ServiceDesk, upgrading the Xerox XMPie suite, and establishing an AWS cloud solution for imagery hosting.
parentsummary.outcomes: Delivered a structured Agile delivery framework with consolidated project management and reporting for GC client departments, a functioning ITIL ServiceDesk, and an AWS-hosted imagery platform — enabling the software development team to operate with measurable discipline and client-facing governance.

challenge.summary: The client was performing extensive internal change, which required the re-organization of the Software Development team from an unstructured and chaotic team into a fluid Agile and Scrum based team.

deliverables: Project Management using Agile & Scrum techniques
Project Management of IBM WebSphere, Java, and UI/UX projects
Project Management of WebSphere Individual Customer Web Store for each customer
Configuration and management of Atlassian JIRA and Confluence project and space environments
Facilitated Agile workflow requirements with customer service, sales, client, and executive representatives
Implementation of consolidated data project management and reporting system for GC Client Departments
Architected the Atlassian JIRA permission scheme separating internal staff access from external GC client access
Project Planning, Architecture, and Deployment of ITIL based ServiceDesk
Provided knowledge transfer and training to internal FTE staff
Project Planning, Architecture and Upgrade Deployment of Xerox XMPie Suite
AWS Cloud Solution for Imagery Hosting

outcomes: Transformed the Lowe Martin software development team from an unstructured model to a structured Agile and Scrum delivery organization with standardized sprint cadences and backlog management
Deployed Atlassian JIRA with a permission scheme segregating internal staff access from Government of Canada client access, enabling compliant multi-client project management
Established an ITIL-based ServiceDesk and AWS cloud imagery hosting platform, improving IT service structure and reducing manual image distribution overhead
